title: Market, castle garden, Tenjinbashi, A5 wagyu, Umeda sunset

items.text: Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Daikokuchō, exit 1, 3 min walk.
Fish breakfast: seafood bowl or market sushi. Cash only; many stalls close by ~11:00.
Metro Daikokuchō → Tanimachi 4-chōme, then walk ~10 min.
Castle garden with a view of the keep. ¥300; Nov–Feb 9:00–16:30 (last entry 16:00), closed Mon.
Tanimachi Line Tanimachi 4-chōme → Minami-morimachi, then 5 min walk.
Coffee to go. Osaka Tenmangū is next door (9:00–17:00): 📿 stamp there.
Walk north along the arcade; light snacks only.
A5 wagyu lunch (not Kobe): pick one of the three below on the day.
Yakiniku: thin slices you grill yourselves. ~¥6,000–8,000 pp. Lunch last order 14:00.
Teppanyaki: thick steak cooked by the chef; choose cut and grams. A5 lean 100 g ¥8,580. Last order 15:00. Not the Sakura Beef set (not A5).
Teppanyaki steak. Ask for A5 Kuroge wagyu, not Kobe; non-Kobe price not found. Lunch until 15:00.
Pre-war lanes with the cafés open; ~10 min from Umeda.
Dinner in Fukushima. Suggestion for chicken skin: O26a Ichiya.
Walk to Nishi-Umeda, Yotsubashi Line → Tamade. Home ~20:30.
